note: Hand-derived from .design/stage1-forge-tier.md REQ-5 + AC-9 — the FROZEN forge-tier proof battery. Two closed sets: the tactic allowlist an author `proof { … }` / `lemma … proof { … }` block (the 2a verbatim-captured surface) may cite, and the simp-lemma set a `simp [ … ]` citation in those blocks may name. The simp set is the EXACT `simp only [ … ]` list the generated auto battery emits (forge/src/lean_export.rs `auto_tactic_battery`), the single auditable source of what the frozen battery knows how to rewrite; a citation outside it is an unlisted simp lemma (refused at elaboration), and a residual goal mentioning a symbol the set does not normalize is the `missing simp bridge` Stuck hint (RFC-1 §8). Modeled byte-for-byte on the combinator oracle (tests/golden/combinators/registry.json, R-CHAR-3): the registry is FROZEN — adding/removing/changing an entry is a design-doc amendment, not a code-local choice.
